subject: Request: Squad capacity patch & off-cycle offer approval for KeenCloud AE
messages:
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodai.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodai.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodai.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodai.com>
Date: 2027-12-08T08:14:00-08:00
Subject: Urgent: patching Q1 AE capacity for KeenCloud RFP

Hi Soojin / Marissa,

KeenCloud (prospect) just signaled they want a formal commercial proposal by next Tuesday and have requested a dedicated AE for the pilot. Recruiting today confirmed we don’t have an immediately open AE req with profile fit for a quick start.

Ask: Can we temporarily repurpose one solution-seat from the FY24 backlog (closed req 312) and approve an off-cycle offer to a vetted contractor-to-hire candidate (Alyssa Chen) so we can include a named AE in the proposal?

Why this matters:
- Deal velocity: KeenCloud has a competitive PoC timeline and explicit preference for a single point of contact.
- Signal: Having a named AE materially increases conversion probability per our playbook.
- Timing: Candidate is available to start 4 weeks after offer; recruiting can turn paperwork quickly.

Initial details (recruiting provided):
- Candidate: Alyssa Chen (ex-enterprise AE at BrightEdge)
- Proposed comp: Base $140k, OTE $260k (standard for mid-market AE in west coast), sign-on pro-rated $10k
- Start window: Target 01/10/2028

I attached a short memo that outlines the repurposing plan and suggested backfill timing. If we can get a one-off approval for compensation band + seat repurpose, I’ll instruct recruiting to extend the offer and align with finance on proration.

Thanks,
Hannah

--
Hannah Schmitt
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwoodai.com
Attachment: capacity-repurposing-memo.docx (memo, 2 pages)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwoodai.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodai.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodai.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodai.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodai.com>
Date: 2027-12-08T10:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Urgent: patching Q1 AE capacity for KeenCloud RFP

Thanks Hannah — quick clarifying questions before I escalate to comp: 

1) Is the $140k base + $260k OTE within our current AE comp bands for US-West mid-market? If not, please state the requested deviation.
2) Why closed req 312 specifically (any dependencies or hiring freeze notes)?
3) Do we expect this to be an ongoing headcount increase or a temporary seat repurpose (i.e., will we need to backfill immediately)?

If you can answer briefly I’ll pull Karthik in for a band exception review and propose approval conditions (time-limited, can’t convert to net-new without approval).

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodai.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwoodai.com>
Date: 2027-12-08T12:35:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Urgent: patching Q1 AE capacity for KeenCloud RFP

Quick read and decision: I approve a limited comp-band exception and seat repurpose under the following conditions:

- Compensation: Base $145,000, OTE capped at $270,000 (we will treat the $10k sign-on as an upfront one-time payment). This sits slightly above the midpoint for our US-West AE band but within tolerance given deal priority.
- Duration: Seat repurposing approved until 2028-06-30. By 2028-06-01 hiring partners must present a backfill plan or the seat will revert to central hiring inventory.
- Conversion: Any conversion from contractor-to-hire to a net-new headcount requires a full HC request and approvals (no auto-conversion).
- Reporting: Alyssa must be added to the KeenCloud pipeline in CRM and flagged for revenue attribution to enable accurate forecasting.

Attached: comp-band-exception.xlsx (band signoff table) and approval memo for records. HR/Finance should run proration and recode the seat to the pilot cost center 4321 for Q1.

I sign off subject to HR completing background and reference checks; recruiting can extend the offer once those are green-lit.

-Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer
SVP, Go-to-Market Finance & Compensation | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwoodai.com
Attachment: comp-band-exception.xlsx, approval-memo.pdf

Date: 2027-12-08T16:02:00-08:00
Subject: FINAL: Approved — KeenCloud AE off-cycle offer (Alyssa Chen)

Thanks all — per Karthik's signoff Im granting a one-time approval to move forward with the off-cycle offer under the outlined constraints. Next steps:

1) Recruiting: Issue the offer using the attached KeenCloud AE offer template (base $145k, OTE $270k, $10k sign-on). Mark role as 'repurposed seat - pilot' and use cost center 4321.
2) HR Ops: Complete background + references ASAP and confirm start date availability. Please update HRREQ-741 with finalization steps and expected start 01/10/2028.
3) Finance: Confirm proration schedule and ensure payroll coding for Q1 pilot budget.
4) Sales Ops: Add Alyssa to CRM, assign to KeenCloud opportunity, and flag for revenue attribution to the pilot.

Hannah: please include the named AE in the proposal you send to KeenCloud and attach the offer-in-progress language as "subject to background checks". Once Recruiting confirms candidate acceptance, loop Legal for standard SOW/engagement terms.

Ill archive the approval memo and comp exception to the HR folder for audit. Thanks for moving fast on this — keep me posted on candidate acceptance.

So-ojin
